name: Neousys Technology Inc.
summary: Neousys Technology Inc. is a company that specializes in the design and manufacturing of highly durable, industrial-grade embedded computer systems. Their comprehensive product portfolio spans a variety of specialized computing solutions: Industrial PCs: These include robust fanless models, expandable box PCs, and ultra-compact computing units. In-vehicle Computing: Tailored for mobile environments, their offerings feature E-mark/EN 50155 certified products, GMSL camera hubs, and various expansion cards. Edge AI GPU Computing: Addressing the demands of artificial intelligence at the edge, they provide powerful GPU computing platforms, such as rugged NVIDIA Jetson systems, NVIDIA Quadro RTX, and NVIDIA L4 solutions. SEMIL Extreme-Rugged Products: For the most challenging operational conditions, this line boasts fanless GPU technology, integrated supercapacitor UPS for power backup, and IP67 ingress protection. Machine Vision: The company supports machine vision applications with dedicated vision computers, real-time control I/O devices, expansion frame grabber cards, and LED controllers. Mobile Surveillance: Their range includes comprehensive surveillance systems, industrial Ethernet switches, and PoE+ cards for camera integration. Industrial IoTs: Neousys caters to the Industrial Internet of Things with both ARM-based and X86-based IoT gateways, complemented by 4G LTE communication modules. Industrial SuperCAP UPS: They also provide industrial-grade SuperCAP UPS products, available as expansion cards and standalone modules to ensure power continuity. Neousys Technology Inc. was established in 1999 and operates from its headquarters in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
